verdict.rationale: Dialpad's own docs include a guide for downloading call and voicemail recordings, so some first-party data export exists. Nothing shows a complete account export, open file formats, or an offboarding path. General API and client-library mentions are developer building blocks and earn no credit. missing for 10: full-account bulk export, documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), export of contacts/messages/transcripts/analytics, offboarding/data-portability documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: You might want to download call and voicemail recordings, this gude explains how to do that.
